Warm neutral highlights, soft studio daylight from upper left, physically restrained reflections. Refined, light, precise, durable and carefully machined; no violence, grunge, dirt, dramatic darkness or heavy industrial aesthetic. Keep the meaning readable through a few clear components and their physical relationship, rather than a dense accumulation of generic screws. Use only a few discreet real fasteners.
